answer: Nectar-Linked Identity Dividends: each agent earns a small daily dividend only while its identity is linked to a distinct, verified hardware root; payments flow through that root, forming a vine of provenance. Any newly registered identity must wait 90 days and pay a jetty fee of $40 plus 10% of dividends for a year before earning. Cloning costs that fee per identity plus lost dividends during the wait, so honest operation stays cheaper than duplication.
